version: v5 (2026-10-07 night): symmetric squat facing the prince across a 0.60 m lid, pinch pick, 7 strokes, put back, point at the drawing, look up, hold
first_frame: Breathing Idle frame 1 on Unity's idle feet (see check_summary.frame1_vs_unity_idle_mm)
last_frame: squatting, right index pointing at the drawing, face toward the prince's eyes (hold with breathing)
space: Unity, relative to the pilot root; metres; quaternions x y z w. Pilot_Sketchbook pivot = spine midpoint on the outer cover; Pilot_Pencil pivot = graphite tip, its long axis toward the cap is the pivot's +Y in Unity (Blender +Z) (pencil mesh scaled to 190 x 12 mm, see draw_layout.json)
tip_uv: pencil tip on the right page in Pilot_Sketchbook's UV (Page04_Box); pen_down while the tip is on the paper; reveal along the tip's path

layout.space: Unity axes (x right, y up, z forward); 'pilot' = squatting pilot root (Mixamo Crouching Idle frame 1) at the origin facing +z (his hip joints' middle over the origin; Blender here: facing -Y, left +X). Crate = Camp_Crate_M pivot (base centre, lid along its local x). Book = Pilot_Sketchbook pivot (spine midpoint on the outer cover, +Y book top, +Z paper normal). Pencil = Pilot_Pencil pivot (graphite tip, +Z toward the cap).

pencil_on_crate.note: standing in the cup (v6); see pencil_stand

pencil_put_back.note: where P_Draw puts the pencil back: 0 mm further to his right than where it lay (book-local +x), clear of the right hand's turn and grip

crate_from_anchor_local.note: anchor local: fwd = his feet (yaw 30), left = his left; the prince's sleep spot / the player's approach is on his left front

scene.note: y = terrain height at the anchor (flat dish); re-sample the ground at crate_world in Unity. The squatting pilot faces the plane (PlaneWreck pivot).

pencil_pick_in_hand_r.note: pencil pivot in hand.r space at the pinch (Blender bone space converted with the same axis swap); writing grip: export/draw_grip.json

crate_height.note: Camp_Crate_M z-scaled about its base (footprint unchanged); the book lies on the boards at lid_boards_z; crate_frame.book / book_frame.* are relative to this scaled crate's pivot

wrist_bone.hand_r: ARP hand.r (Unity: RightHand); pos = the wrist joint (bone head), rot = the bone's orientation in the pilot frame
wrist_bone.index_tip_r: tail of c_index3.r (the right index fingertip), pilot frame

pencil_stand.note: v6: the pencil STANDS in a tin cup filled with sand beside the book's right fore-edge; Pilot_Pencil (the taken one) is tracked per frame as before, the cup, the sand and the extra pencils are static props. Transforms in the crate frame (Unity axes; crate pivot = base centre of the scaled Camp_Crate_M).
